{{Top|leg}}
'''Sybar''' was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] during the [[Rebellion era]].<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref> He<ref name="QL">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030814web|text=Quick Locations}}</ref> fought for control over the underworld life at [[Votrad Independent Downport]] in the city of [[Votrad]].<ref name="PSG" />

Members of [[Sybar's criminal syndicate]] avoided a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] ambush and holed up in a debris field, and were believed to be setting traps, retrieving caches of weapons and supplies, and/or recruiting local [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] while awaiting Sybar's [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. It was believed that if these fugitives were not apprehended before their rescue, Sybar's syndicate would reestablish its foothold in the nearby starport and Sybar would seek revenge on those who rooted them out.<ref name="QL" />
